en.headline: Palace Museum opens Qing imperial workshop exhibition
en.dek: Design for the Forbidden City, jointly organised with Beijing's Palace Museum, puts more than 150 workshop objects on view in Gallery 5 from Wednesday.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum opened Design for the Forbidden City: Imperial Workshops of the Qing Court to the public on Wednesday in Gallery 5 at the West Kowloon museum. The show is jointly organised with the Palace Museum in Beijing.

It looks at the Zaobanchu, the Qing court's workshops that designed, made and repaired palace objects from the Kangxi reign until the early twentieth century. The museum said the display uses more than 150 objects from the Beijing collection to explain the office's history, structure, materials and methods, and that Hong Kong designers took part in the presentation. Local reports of Tuesday's media preview put the loan at 157 pieces, including 14 Grade-One cultural relics.

Highlights named by the museum include a peach-shaped box in coral and gold from the Yongzheng reign and the Jin'ou Yonggu cup of 1797, worked in gold with pearls, rubies, sapphires and kingfisher feather. The exhibition is arranged in three sections on what the workshops were, how objects were made, and how they were designed and displayed. Some objects will be rotated during the run.

The exhibition is included in a standard museum ticket and is scheduled to continue until 4 November 2030. The museum is open from 10am to 6pm on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, and from 10am to 8pm on Friday, Saturday and public holidays, including National Day on Thursday. It is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays. The building stands at 8 Museum Drive, West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 香港故宮開展清宮製造與當代設計
zh.dek: 與北京故宮博物院合辦的專題展周三起在西九展廳五對外開放，展出造辦處文物一百五十多件。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館周三起在西九文化區展廳五向公眾開放專題展覽「清宮製造與當代設計」，由香港故宮與北京故宮博物院聯合主辦。
展覽聚焦清代宮廷造辦處，介紹由康熙年間設立至二十世紀初解散的御用工坊如何設計、製作及修繕宮廷器物。館方指展出故宮博物院藏品一百五十多件，講述沿革、架構、用料與工序，並邀請香港設計師參與呈現。周二傳媒預展的報道指展品共157件，包括14件國家一級文物。
館方點名展品包括雍正朝珊瑚金海水雲龍福壽紋桃式盒，以及嘉慶二年金瓯永固杯，以金為胎並鑲珍珠、紅寶石、藍寶石及翠羽。展覽分「何謂造辦處」「器物製作與工藝創新」「創意設計與陳設」三部分，部分展品會於展期內更換。
展覽包含在博物館標準門票內，展期至2030年11月4日。開館時間為周一、三、四、日上午十時至下午六時，周五、六及公眾假期上午十時至晚上八時，星期四國慶日按公眾假期開放；周二除公眾假期外休館。場地在西九文化區博物館道8號。
